title: xAI Grok Build CLI Uploads Entire Repos and Git History

facts.fact: In the vendor's own test, a 12 GB repository moved 5.10 GiB through storage endpoints.
facts.quote: One test with a 12 GB repository moved 5.10 GiB through storage endpoints.

facts.fact: In the same 12 GB test, conversation channels carried only 192 KB.
The page reports the storage-path volume as roughly 27,800 times the conversation-path volume in the 12 GB test.
facts.quote: The ratio reached roughly 27,800 times more volume on the storage path.

facts.fact: The post says session data reaches both xAI endpoints and a Google Cloud Storage bucket named grok-code-session-traces.
facts.quote: Session data reaches both xAI endpoints and a Google Cloud Storage bucket named grok-code-session-traces.

facts.fact: The post says the trace upload flag persists across restarts and that no UI switch currently disables the flow.
facts.quote: The flag persists across restarts. No UI switch currently disables the flow.

facts.fact: The post says the separation between uploads and agent read operations appears hard-coded in version 0.2.93.
facts.quote: This separation appears hard-coded in version 0.2.93.

facts.fact: The post says both the /v1/responses and /v1/storage routes returned HTTP 200 responses confirming acceptance.
facts.quote: Both routes return HTTP 200 responses confirming acceptance.

facts.fact: The post states that no public documentation lists the storage bucket or its retention policy.
facts.quote: No public documentation lists the storage bucket or its retention policy.

facts.fact: The post states its analysis did not confirm training use of the data, but verified transmission, receipt, and storage.
facts.quote: The analysis did not confirm training use of the data but verified transmission, receipt, and storage.

facts.fact: The post says the network traffic analysis revealed three data streams.
facts.quote: Analysis of network traffic revealed three data streams.

facts.fact: The post is dated July 13 and was updated July 20; the year is not stated.
remio, the page's publisher, states it currently supports Windows 10+ (x64) and Macs with Apple silicon.
facts.quote: remio currently supports Windows 10+ (x64) and Macs with Apple silicon.

facts.fact: remio advertises a Black Friday sale of 30% off its annual plans.
facts.quote: Black Friday Sale: 30% Off Annual Plans
